purpose: Bounded prospective exact-source exhaustion for frozen V2A SOFID / sofiusd after Bullish exact-market identity passed but frozen missing-daily-bucket QA failed on 2026-08-29.
qualification_requirements: The Kraken source must remain official, public, auditable and accessible for market-data qualification without private credentials.
Exact Kraken asset and market identity must match frozen V2A coin_id=sofiusd and symbol=SOFID; a commercial price page or ticker equality alone is insufficient.
The exact spot pair must be discovered from the official Kraken Assets/AssetPairs public API before any historical request is treated as qualification evidence.
Physical qualification must preserve raw response bytes and SHA-256 before normalization.
Provider, exact pair, endpoint, request parameters, retrieval timestamp, raw hash and parser/schema version must be recorded.
Timestamp semantics/timezone and deterministic schema mapping must be explicit.
Duplicate, missing-bucket, monotonic-time, OHLC and nonnegative-volume QA must pass fail-closed where exposed.
Observed gaps remain negative evidence and cannot be synthesized, stitched across sources or silently repaired.
Qualification is prospective-source readiness only and earns zero D0, epoch, historical or scientific credit.
A clean physical qualification requires a separate read-only adjudication before inclusion in any exact-source registry or cutover assessment.
